dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white patches are visible across the wing coverts and primary feathers, appearing as distinct white blocks against a dark grey/black background.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent boundaries exist between the large white patches and the surrounding dark feather bodies on the folded wings.

other_distinctive_markers: Bold, high-contrast white plumage patches are located on the lower wing and rump/lower back area.
